description: Implementation of UserSettings management, including configuration, notification registration, value setting/getting, and migration state handling within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Implements user settings management, including configuration, notification handling, and migration state tracking within the plugin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up remote store object, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles value change events from the store and dispatches corresponding notifications.

methods.name: SetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Sets a user setting value in the remote store.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Retrieves a user setting value from the remote store, falling back to defaults if necessary.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting key requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all user settings.
